projects.title: Gamified Web-based Portfolio Tracker
projects.description: A full-stack web app for tracking investments and savings with institutional-grade risk analytics (Beta, Sharpe Ratio, Variance) layered with gamification (XP, ranks, achievements). The goal was to keep beginner investors motivated to build good habits, while still giving advanced investors real portfolio analysis. Built with Node.js, PostgreSQL and live market data from the Financial Modeling Prep API.

projects.title: Unofficial MTS Stock Shortage System
projects.description: Warehouse operatives at Micheldever had no reliable way to track and report short stock to stock operatives, which caused loading delays. I built a full-stack web app so stock operatives could view and resolve shortages in real time, giving loading teams instant visibility and cutting unnecessary delays. Building this wasn't part of the job, just a real operational problem I wanted to solve.

projects.title: Unofficial MTS Salary & Budget Calculator
projects.description: My first project built with HTML and JavaScript/jQuery. I wanted a simple, business-specific tool anyone could use (even outside Micheldever), so I experimented with Micheldever's colour scheme and kept it as clean as possible. It also includes a budgeting feature that works out how much money you have left against forecasted pay, visualised with an ApexCharts donut chart.

projects.title: Blog Website
projects.description: A capstone project from The Complete Web Development Bootcamp. It let me apply my EJS and API skills to build a fully functioning blog with full CRUD — users can create, edit and delete posts, all driven by a REST API built on Express.js.
